verdict.rationale: MailerSend's developer docs say it ships official libraries for multiple programming languages and call them the easiest way to integrate, so it directly offers official SDKs. The evidence does not show which languages are covered or how deep each SDK goes. Missing for 10: the specific language list and per-SDK API coverage, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: MailerSend supports this list of official libraries for your favorite programming language. This is the easiest way to integrate MailerSend with your application.
